plan: Given my private value of $35 for this item, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit if I win while minimizing risk. Since bids must be in $0.1 increments, I will bid $30. This allows room to profit if the third-highest bid is lower while minimizing the risk of overpaying. I will not bid my full value to avoid scenarios where winning provides no net gain. This strategy balances the potential profit and risk effectively.
